title: Muszine (2025)
description:
Muszine is a collaborative magazine (A5) created as a collection of works from the year it is made. It serves as a time capsule for the creative output of its creators within that period. It aims to be as open as possible in its presentation of different mediums by selecting the creator, rather than the work itself. Therefore, it highlights themes and expressions that would usually remain unseen in expositions, shows, social media, or everyday life.

Participants: Hannah Zeeman, Arno Zeeman, Sofie Wortelboer, Zainab Goelaman, Eleri Lee, Malte Hultgren, Juwan Moon, Sahra Alipour, Begoña Garcia Marina, Greta Ona Galiauskaitė, Tomas Ornaghi, Leo Mokkala, Fanja Bouts, Pleuntje Valkhoff, Marion Lecoq, Laura Eager, Haskell Tichell, Madeleine Homan, Jorn Vlaanderen.

Made by Mus.
